Watercolor on thin, beige, slightly textured laid paper, Japanese paper
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Harold Diamond, New York, NY, purchase, 1977; (Joshua Strychalski, New York, NY); Middendorf Gallery, Washington, DC, 1978; Private collection, Jacksonville, Florida, 1980; (Middendorf Gallery, Washington, DC); Doris Bry, New York, NY, 1981; (Joan T. Washburn, New York, NY, 1986); William Dean, New York, NY, 1986; Middendorf Gallery, Washington, DC, 1986; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1987 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence; completed in New York or Virginia before August move to Texas. See cat. nos. 81, 83. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: An amorphous blob of flowing blue, green, and red paint occupies the center of the paper. Patches of yellow dot the image. The form resembles a dark, colorful cloud, and contrasts with the plain white paper framing it.
title: Untitled (Red, Blue and Green)
